instruction: Create a bookmark titled 'Wikipedia' for 'https://www.wikipedia.org' in Chrome's bookmarks bar.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a bookmark website to the bookmarks bar with a specific URL and title. The evaluator uses a custom metric function is_expected_bookmarks__2ad9387a with bookmark_bar_websites_with_titles type to verify the bookmark exists with correct URL and title.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirements: adding a bookmark to bookmarks bar with specific URL and title
Getter 'get_bookmarks' correctly reads Chrome's Bookmarks JSON file from disk to extract bookmark state

Metric 'is_expected_bookmarks__2ad9387a' implements correct verification logic: (1) extracts bookmark_bar children, (2) filters for type='url' bookmarks, (3) maps Chrome's 'name' field to 'title', (4) normalizes URLs by removing trailing slash, (5) checks both URL and title match expected values
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome (pkill + relaunch) to ensure bookmarks are flushed to disk before verification
Expected values are semantically correct: URL='https://www.wikipedia.org/' and title='Wikipedia' exactly match instruction requirements
Complete coverage: evaluator checks both required fields (URL and title) in the correct location (bookmarks bar)
Runtime feasibility: getter can access standard Chrome Bookmarks file location, metric logic is robust with proper error handling and logging
